Every successful case compares aggregate.png as well, drawn by plot/hicexplorer_plot/hicAggregateContacts.py from the aggregates the C++ computes; only hicAggregateContacts.spectral.ignored keeps --noPlot. The p_*.tab contact pairs are written in np.argsort order of the centre value. numpy 1.26 orders equal keys differently with and without its AVX-512 argsort, and the port uses the order without it on every CPU, so the order of lines with an equal centre value is not compared (option tie_column -1 of the text comparator: each run of consecutive lines with the same last column is sorted before the byte comparison; the lines, their runs and the order of the runs must be identical).
